mappings.rationale: KBLI2020 code 19291 ('Industri Produk Dari Hasil Kilang Minyak Bumi') was a broad catch-all for petroleum-refinery-derived products. BPS Lampiran 5 (2020->2025, p.154/printed p.140) shows THREE consecutive rows all sourced from 19291, fanning into 19205 (Industri Briket), 19206 (this code), and 19209 (Industri Produk Lainnya dari Hasil Kilang Minyak Bumi). Lampiran 10 (2025->2020, p.347/printed p.333) confirms the same fan-out in the reverse direction for the same three targets -- bidirectionally verified, not a one-off parse artifact. The differentiation is semantic, not title-string coincidence: 19206's own uraian specifies 'pencampuran produk dari hasil kilang minyak bumi dengan biofuel, seperti pencampuran alkohol dengan minyak bumi (misalnya gasohol) dan pencampuran diesel dengan FAME (biosolar)' -- a BLENDING/MIXING process. This is corroborated verbatim by the live OSS parent-subgolongan (1920) uraian (oss/relasi.json), which lists 'pencampuran biofuel, seperti pencampuran alkohol dengan minyak bumi (misalnya gasohol)' as an INCLUDED 1920 activity while explicitly EXCLUDING 'pembuatan biofuel cair' (biofuel manufacturing proper, routed to subgolongan 2029) and excluding solid biomass fuel (1629). So the carve criterion BPS used was physical form/process: liquid-blend product (->19206) vs solid briquette (->19205, which additionally absorbed the separate 2020 code 19292 'Industri Briket Batu Bara') vs residual/other refinery output (->19209 catch-all). Because one 2020 source demonstrably fans into 3 distinct, semantically-differentiated 2025 targets (confirmed in both crosswalk directions), the correct mapping_type is SPLIT, not the flatter 'renumber' framing implied by canonical.json's status_mapping='CODICE_RINUMERATO'.

One extra observation surfaced during image review (relevant to a future D2 pass, not to this D1 crosswalk verdict): the PP28 image shows THREE kewenangan tiers for the Kecil/Menengah row (Bupati/Walikota, Gubernur, Menteri/Kepala Badan) each keyed to a different location-scope parameter, but canonical.json's per_skala[0].kewenangan only surfaces 'Bupati/Walikota' -- the other two tiers are folded into the flattened 'parameter' string without a matching kewenangan value. Not a crosswalk defect, flagging for D2 completeness check. oss/ABSENT.json correctly recorded ruang_lingkup and umku as absent (404) rather than fabricated.
